name: humanizer
title: Humanizer: remove AI writing patterns
description: Rewrites AI-sounding text so it reads like a person wrote it, without changing what it says. Detects and removes the 25 AI writing tells from Wikipedia's 'Signs of AI writing'. Send any text; get back a human-sounding rewrite plus the draft and the tells that remained.

text.title: Text to humanize
text.description: The AI-sounding text you want rewritten. Everything else stays the same: facts, names, numbers, and quotes are kept.
text.prefill: I recently spent five unforgettable days in Lisbon, and let me tell you — this city completely stole my heart. From the moment I arrived, I knew I was somewhere truly special.

voiceSample.title: Writing sample (optional)
voiceSample.description: Two or three paragraphs of your own writing. The rewrite matches your rhythm, word choice, punctuation, and quirks.

model.title: Model
model.description: Any OpenRouter model slug, such as openai/gpt-5.4-mini or anthropic/claude-sonnet-4. See openrouter.ai/models for the catalog.

baseUrl.title: OpenAI-compatible API base URL
baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions base URL. Defaults to the Apify OpenRouter proxy, which is billed to the Apify account. Set it to https://api.openai.com/v1 or another provider to use your own apiKey.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Sampling temperature between 0 and 2. Lower is more consistent, higher is more varied.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Optional. Only needed when baseUrl points at a provider other than the Apify OpenRouter proxy. Stored encrypted and only used for the LLM call.
